projectWorkspace.primary: This is the project’s primary codebase workspace.

projectWorkspace.intro: Configure the concrete workspace Paperclip attaches to this project. These values drive per-workspace checkout behavior, default runtime services for child execution workspaces, and let you override setup or cleanup commands when one workspace needs special handling.
projectWorkspace.name: Workspace name
projectWorkspace.setupHint: Runs when this workspace needs custom bootstrap
projectWorkspace.cleanupHint: Runs before project-level execution workspace teardown
projectWorkspace.advancedJsonHelp: Paperclip derives Services and Jobs from this JSON. Prefer editing named commands first; use raw JSON for advanced lifecycle, port, readiness, or environment settings.
projectWorkspace.commandsHint: Execution workspaces inherit this config unless they override it. Legacy `services` arrays still work, but `commands` supports both services and jobs.
projectWorkspace.servicesHelp: Long-running services stay supervised here, while one-shot jobs run on demand against this workspace. Execution workspaces inherit this config unless they override it.
projectWorkspace.noServicesStarted: No services have been started for this workspace yet.
projectWorkspace.noCommandConfig: No workspace command config is defined for this workspace yet.
projectWorkspace.noJobs: No one-shot jobs are configured for this workspace yet.
projectWorkspace.disabledHint: Project workspaces need a working directory before local commands can run, and services also need runtime config.
projectWorkspace.serviceStopped: Workspace service stopped. Task execution is not paused.
projectWorkspace.serviceRestarted: Workspace service restarted. Task execution is not paused.

source.localGitHelp: A local path Paperclip can use directly.
source.nonGitHelp: A local folder without git semantics.

routines.title: Routines
routines.description: Recurring work definitions that materialize into auditable execution tasks.
routines.selectOrg: Select an organization to view routines.
routines.composerHelp: Define the recurring work first. Default project and agent are optional for draft routines.
routines.advancedHelp: Keep policy controls secondary to the work definition.
routines.afterCreate: After creation, Paperclip takes you straight to trigger setup. Draft routines stay paused until you add a default agent.
routines.empty: No active routines. Use Create routine to define the first recurring workflow.

concurrencyPolicy.coalesce_if_active: If a run is already active, keep just one follow-up run queued.
concurrencyPolicy.always_enqueue: Queue every trigger occurrence, even if the routine is already running.
concurrencyPolicy.skip_if_active: Drop new trigger occurrences while a run is still active.

catchUpPolicy.skip_missed: Ignore windows that were missed while the scheduler or routine was paused.
catchUpPolicy.enqueue_missed_with_cap: Catch up missed schedule windows after recovery; sub-hourly schedules are combined into one catch-up run, slower schedules replay each missed window up to a cap.

decisions.emptyHelp: Decisions land here when they match the queue's rules or an agent adds them.
decisions.noMatch: No decisions match your search or filters.
decisions.noMatchHelp: Adjust or clear your search and filters to see the rest.
decisions.agingHelp: Idle past {{days}} days — kept off the queue. Keep any you still want surfaced.
decisions.seedingOnHelp: This queue fills itself automatically. Decisions are added the moment they match any of its rules:
decisions.seedingOffHelp: Automatic adds are paused. These rules would add decisions to the queue when on:
decisions.seedingOnNote: Turning it off stops new automatic adds only — decisions already here stay, and you can still add or remove decisions by hand.
decisions.seedingOffNote: Adding or removing decisions by hand still works while automatic seeding is off.

costs.noFinanceTimeline: No finance events yet. Add account-level charges once biller invoices or credits land.
costs.controlPlaneHelp: Hard-stop spend limits for agents and projects. Provider subscription quota stays separate and appears under Providers.
costs.activeIncidentsHelp: Open soft or hard threshold crossings

costs.resolveHelp: Resolve hard stops here by raising the budget or explicitly keeping the scope paused.

costs.noBillable: No billable events in this period.
costs.byBillerHelp: Account-level financial events grouped by who charged or credited them.
costs.ledgerHelp: Account-level charges that do not map to a single inference request.
costs.netHelp: Debit minus credit for the selected period
costs.estimatedHelp: Estimated debits that are not yet invoice-authoritative

statusCards.title: Status
statusCards.emptyHelp: Create a card to keep a living summary of the issues you care about.
statusCards.createHelp: One message sets up the whole card: say what you want to watch and what each update should tell you. The agent builds the query from it and writes every update against it.
statusCards.promptLabel: What do you want to keep an eye on?
statusCards.promptPlaceholder: Keep an eye on the ID and Cloud projects. Tell me whether the service is live, and if not, the exact three actions needed to get it to production.
statusCards.example3: is feature X live? if not, the exact next actions to ship it
statusCards.agentHelp: Runs this card's setup and updates. Leave on the default unless another agent should own it.
statusCards.pausedBudget: Daily token cap reached — auto-updates paused
statusCards.compilingHelp: You can add instructions and pick an update policy while this runs.
statusCards.refreshQueued: Refresh queued — the Summarizer is updating this card.
statusCards.runQueued: Run queued — the Summarizer is updating this card.
statusCards.setupAuto: Setting up — the first summary is generated automatically once this finishes.
statusCards.setupRetry: Setup didn’t finish. Run it now to try again.
statusCards.watchesHelp: This one message drives the whole card: the agent compiles the watch query from it and follows it as the instructions for every update. Editing it rebuilds the card.
statusCards.stillSettingUp: This card is still setting up — the issues it watches appear here once it's ready.
statusCards.noMatches: The compiled query matches no issues right now.
statusCards.compiledHelp: Compiled by Summarizer {{when}} · version {{version}}. Edit “What this card watches” above to rebuild it.
statusCards.notCompiled: Not compiled yet. The query builds automatically once the card finishes setting up.
statusCards.manual: Manual only — updates when I press refresh
statusCards.interval: On a schedule, only if something changed
statusCards.estimateNote: Rough estimate from typical update sizes; actual cost is tracked per update.

triggers.statusTransitions: Became blocked / needs review / done / cancelled

triggers.anyUpdate: Any update at all (noisy — includes in-progress churn)

audit.title: Audit
audit.description: Review what happened, inspect agent runs, and understand the costs and budget controls behind your organization.
audit.selectOrg: Select an organization to view Audit.
audit.selectActivity: Select an organization to view activity.
audit.routineRunsHelp: Executions created by this routine, newest first.
audit.showingRoutineRuns: Showing the {{count}} most recent routine runs.
audit.runsHelp: Recent agent executions across the organization. Open a run to inspect its transcript, output, and task context.

auditFeed.agentsHelp: Every recorded agent action, newest first — with the responsible person and run behind each one.
auditFeed.allHelp: Everything happening in your organization, newest first — people, agents, and the system. Each line is one recorded action.
auditFeed.exportFailedBody: Could not export the audit log.
auditFeed.loadFailed: Failed to load the audit log.
auditFeed.widerFilters: Try a wider date range or different filters.
auditFeed.agentsEmpty: As soon as your agents start doing things, their actions show up here.
auditFeed.allEmpty: As soon as anyone in your organization does something, it shows up here.
auditFeed.footnote: Recorded by Paperclip — entries can't be edited. Sensitive values are never stored.
auditFeed.upsellTitle: Agent audit is a Paperclip Enterprise view
auditFeed.upsellBody: The agent audit log gives you a searchable, exportable record of everything your agents did — every comment, task change, approval, and run — with the responsible person for each action. Ask an administrator to grant you the audit:view_agent_actions permission to view it.
